snippet.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition - Launch Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition is available now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/opus-echo-of-starsong-full-bloom-edition-switch/

OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition is a visual novel style adventure game. Eda, a girl who can hear mysterious sound waves known as starsong, crosses paths with a young man in search of their source. Together, they venture out to the heart of space to unravel an ancient myth.
